posts.author: Nirriti
posts.body:
Ive followed a similar tutorial for an older RPGM. Ive managed to do it on my end, though it took a lot of trials and errors... For one, theres a distinction between 2~3 terms which isnt obvious (length/end/etc). You'd think about one, but it wont work.. I think you need a specific set of START/END keywords/tags for it to work properly, which might depend on the engine. Ive never done that until some months ago. You can do it!
Thats a skill thats a must to learn!
Look up some other tutorials. I tried checking my history but I cant seem to find the one I ended up using (again, was months ago). I seem to remember it was for a much older RPGM. I likely ended up on the dead RPGM site, via the wayback machine.

Did you fill in other metadata fields? In my experience, if you fill in too much it actually prevents the engine from using the looping data. When i make tracks for my game, i usually clear everything that isnt about the loop points
Also just making sure but you set the loop points in samples and not anything else like milliseconds right?
